description: Main window. Only core IPC/events: no shell, no filesystem, no http plugins are exposed to the frontend. All OS access goes through validated Rust commands. allow-start-dragging: the macOS overlay title bar moves the window from data-tauri-drag-region areas. dialog:allow-open: the Gaming center's "Aggiungi gioco" file picker (open only, no save, no filesystem access: the chosen path goes to the validated add_manual_game command).
